The description incorrectly identifies a bar with a value of 2 as one of the lowest. The lowest value on the chart is 1, which corresponds to three different categories ("ISBN", "eISBN", and one of the "друго..." categories). The bar for the category "друго (посочете какво)" with value 2 is not one of the lowest.
